allowed_decisions: accepting one appointment slot inside the objective's stated constraints

collect.question: Confirm you have reached the right office and the department that handles scheduling.
State the kind of appointment Nathan needs, exactly as the objective describes it.
Ask for the earliest available openings and note every option they offer.
Agree on one specific date and time from the options offered.
Ask what Nathan must bring or complete before the appointment (forms, referrals, insurance card, fasting, arrival time).
Ask for a confirmation number or how the confirmation will arrive, and repeat the date, time, and location back to confirm.

end_conditions: The appointment is booked and confirmed (success).
The office offers only times outside the objective's constraints and cannot hold one inside them.
The office cannot complete the booking today and names a concrete next step.
goal: Book (or reschedule) one appointment for Nathan with the office being called, inside the constraints in the call objective. A booked appointment with a confirmed date, time, and location is success; anything the office cannot do today ends as a clear next step, not a vague promise.
loop_in_triggers: The office requires Nathan's date of birth, insurance member ID, or any other personal identifier to book — never guess it and never supply it from memory; hand back to Nathan.
The office requires a payment, a signature, or consent of any kind.
The office will only speak to Nathan himself.
name: appointment_scheduling
success_conditions: A specific date and time are agreed and repeated back.
title: Appointment scheduling
